posts.en:
dsh-task-worktree is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Complete task-scoped git worktrees for DSH: per-repo manifest for durable state, branch-and-path names (slashes allowed, e.g. refactor/logging), bring-back to main or direct commit, optional carry-over of uncommitted main changes.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-4d1d52e95424f320a60e.html
